newsitem.title: USA: Gander Mountain files reorganization plan.
newsitem.headline: Gander Mountain files reorganization plan.

text.p: Gander Mountain Inc said Thursday it filed a joint plan of reorganization together with its wholly owned subsidiaries GMO Inc and GRS Inc, the Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors of Gander Mountain Inc and Holiday Stationstores Inc.
The company also filed a proposed disclosure statement relating to the plan.
It said a hearing is scheduled for December 13 to consider whether its disclosure statement contains adequate data.

Under terms of the joint plan, the company's 12 retail stores and most related assets of the business will be transferred to Holiday Cos, which will pay a purchase price equal to all secured debt, administrative expenses of the bankruptcy, priority claims, plus $19.5 million.
It said $18.5 million will be distributed among unsecured creditors, $500,000 paid pro rata to Gander Mountain preferred holders and $500,000 to holders of the specialty merchandiser's common stock.
To become effective, the plan must be approved by the court, creditors, preferred holders and common shareholders.
